sign: The last town before the edge. Each cairn is a person who said no to the Gilt House.
North: Orrery Ridge. South: the Lantern Span. East: the Span Rift.

lines: Cairn Warden Tamsa: Rest here. The dead don't mind company, as long as it's quiet.
Stonestacker Mathis: I build the cairns. Business is steady. Too steady.
Lantern Girl Ilse: I light the Span every night. Veronne says every lantern is a debt. I say every lantern is a name.
Old Barnaby: I said no to the Gilt House once. They built me a cairn anyway. I'm saving it for later.
Stonecutter Gerwin: I carve the names before they are needed. The Gilt House sends me a list. It is rarely wrong.
Vigil Keeper Hanne: Rest here. The beds are for the living. We check every morning, to be sure.
Chandler Wenzel: Oil, wicks, tonics. Veronne buys the lanterns. The families buy them a second time.

lines: Rope Keeper Thea: The basket goes down to the moor and comes back up. I only count the ropes.
Rope Keeper Thea: Counting the people was making me sad.
